notes.title: “Let’s Seduce the Heroine!” Store Page Up!
notes.content:
Let’s Seduce the Heroine now has a Steam store page up!  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/872450/Lets_Seduce_the_Heroine/]Wishlist it here![/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/872450/Lets_Seduce_the_Heroine/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26932360/6fd70ff4b30c4037bc8527b42ccd37fc5cac8156.png[/img]
[/url]
Let’s Seduce the Heroine is about a girl who is reincarnated into the villainess of an otome game. In order to avoid her scripted demise, she realizes she has to seduce the heroine! It’s a yuri only story where you must survive as the “evil queen” in an otome game.  

The game will be released later this year and i'm very excited about it!

You can wishlist the game on Steam for an email when it’s released, or follow my developer account here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/razzartvisual]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/razzartvisual
[/url]

notes.title: Check out Mizuchi on Steam!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121300/Mizuchi/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26932360/facb0ceee746a6bd04b56c32113395f17bebda6f.png[/img]

The founder of the studio (as well as writer of the game) was the co-writer of my first game, Starlight Vega, and has been a good friend of mine for many years now. notes.title: (18+ Yuri Eroge) "Bloom" Store Page up!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/892740/Bloom/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32938425/8e65aa0e82d0f5e8d5d63348607f79e6d029e1f6.jpg[/img][/url]

Bloom is an 18+ yuri eroge that explores a mismatched relationship between two women. It’s far more adult oriented than my previous titles, and features explicit uncensored yuri scenes, which brings me to my next bit of news:

Thanks to Valve’s recent changes of allowing adult only content, Bloom will be released 100% uncensored on Steam, with no adult patch needed.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/892740/Bloom/

You can wishlist the game on Steam for an email when it’s released, or follow my developer account here: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/razzartvisual

notes.content:
Thanks to Valve's new policy in allowing adult only titles, Love Ribbon's adult patch has been added as a free DLC:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26932360/59c15dace3ea5a3d7f1696c4a7a191278d57fe73.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/943730/Love_Ribbon_Adult_Patch/

notes.title: Love Ribbon增加官方中文! / Love Ribbon in Chinese!
notes.content:
Love Ribbon增加了官方中文，官中标题为《《恋爱纽带》》！感谢白衣汉化组和古登堡计划的联合汉化，希望中文玩家能够愉快地体验游戏内容！谢谢各位长久以来的期待，如果你在汉化内容中发现任何错误，请在这里或者论坛留下反馈。汉化组也会在评论里冒泡，遇到什么问题的话可以在那里留言。
汉化组：作者超萌的XD，总之谢谢大家的等待！

本次更新内容包括：
-新增官方中文，你可以在游戏设置里修改语言选项
-重置了3张游戏CG图
-修复了一些bug


A massive thank you for all their hard work. I can't wait to see what Chinese speaking fans think of Love Ribbon! Additionally, if you have any feedback on the translation or see anything that needs fixing, please use this thread: 

https://steamcommunity.com/id/sd116/recommended/559610/


---------------

Chinese translation added!

Thanks to the wonderful people at Indienova, Project Gutenberg and Hakui Team have brought you Love Ribbon in the Chinese language! The latest update will contain everything here:

-Chinese Language added. You can access it on the title screen up top
-Three CG have been re-done
-Minor programming fixes

A massive thank you for all their hard work. I can't wait to see what Chinese speaking fans think of Love Ribbon! Additionally, if you have any feedback on the translation or see anything that needs fixing, please use this thread: https://steamcommunity.com/id/sd116/recommended/559610/

notes.title: Free "Afterstory" update now live
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/1oRzGjR.jpg[/img]
The Afterstory/Extended Epilogue update for Love Ribbon is now live! This is a free update that adds an additional epilogue piece to Love Ribbon plus new artworks. It will feature the two in more cute situations after the good end, as well as answering the question: How does Iris’ father react to their relationship? 

You can view the new addition in two places: Click the new ‘Afterstory’ button on the title screen or play through the main story to the good end.

This update is applied through Steam automatically, so if it hasn’t appeared yet, try closing and reopening Steam or checking your download settings.

I hope you enjoy seeing Iris and Zoey again plus a sweeter conclusion to their love story. 

-Razz

edit: Fix if the download is not appearing:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/559610/discussions/0/1318835718931684735/

notes.title: Love Ribbon "Afterstory" update coming soon
notes.content:
[img]http://razzartvisual.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/FREEDOM-%E2%98%85.gif[/img]
First off, a huge massive thank you to all the fans of Love Ribbon! I was overjoyed to see so much support for the game in terms of steam reviews (over 300+ and counting!), overseas interest, and so many nice comments about the game.  

I am putting the finishing touches on an update that will add an additional epilogue piece to Love Ribbon. This will feature the two in more cute situations after the good end, as well as answering the question: How does Iris’ father react to their relationship?

This update will be 100% free, so please keep your eyes peeled for when it launches!
